spec: This plan adds CSV and Markdown output formats to the exporter tool, ensuring they handle missing keys gracefully by outputting empty cells. It introduces a `--fields` CLI option to allow users to select and order specific columns for any format. The `--list-formats` option is updated to include the new formats. Existing JSON output remains untouched to preserve byte-for-byte stability, while the registry and CLI are updated to support the new functionality and default to stdout when no output path is specified.

tasks.title: Implement CSV writer module with header and quoting logic
tasks.test: tests/test_formats.py checks that csv output has a header row derived from the first record's keys, subsequent rows are quoted according to Python's csv module standards, and missing keys in records result in empty cells.

tasks.title: Implement Markdown writer module with table formatting and pipe escaping
tasks.test: tests/test_formats.py checks that markdown output is a valid table, pipe characters `|` within values are escaped as `\|`, and missing keys result in empty cells.

tasks.title: Register CSV and Markdown formats in the format registry
tasks.test: tests/test_formats.py checks that `formats.names()` includes 'csv' and 'md' and `formats.get()` returns the correct writer functions for them.

tasks.title: Add --fields CLI option to filter and order columns
tasks.test: tests/test_cli.py checks that `--fields a,b,c` restricts output to only those columns in the specified order for csv, md, json, and text formats.

tasks.title: Add --list-formats CLI option to display available formats
tasks.test: tests/test_cli.py checks that `--list-formats` outputs a list including 'csv' and 'md' alongside existing formats.

tasks.title: Ensure default output is stdout when no path is provided
tasks.test: tests/test_cli.py checks that when no output path is provided, the formatted data is written to stdout rather than a file.
